Hungarian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈzeː]
  • Hyphenation: zé
  • Rhymes: -zeː

Noun

[edit]

zé

  1. The name of the Latin script letter Z/z.

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Zé, pet form of José (“Joseph”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈzɛ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈzɛ/

  • Rhymes: -ɛ
  • Hyphenation: zé

Noun

[edit]

zé m (plural zés)

  1. (derogatory) joe (stereotypical male given name)
    Synonyms: zé-ninguém, gentalha, plebe

Further reading

[edit]
  • “zé”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026

Saramaccan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Dutch zee or perhaps from Sranan Tongo se (also from Dutch).

Noun

[edit]

zé

  1. sea
